audit.whatIsWrong: Five separate fabrications, and two of them are load-bearing. (a) 'Ionian Fervor's shield', 'the shield stacks she's built from Ionian Fervor', 'what her shield/CC can absorb' — Irelia has NO shield anywhere in her kit; Ionian Fervor grants stacking bonus attack speed and, at max stacks, bonus damage on hit. (b) 'Irelia has no hard CC of her own', 'no hard CC on her side', 'Irelia lacks real CC to lock you down' — she has a stun on Flawless Duet, which the full layer of this very page calls the matchup-defining ability. The content and full layers directly contradict each other. (c) Akali's R is called a 'true-damage execute' twice; Riot's text says magic damage. (d) wants.foe[2] names 'Transcendent Blades', which is not an Irelia ability. (e) wants.foe[1] refers to 'Trueshot-adjacent all-ins', which means nothing here.
audit.why: Riot's texts: passive is attack speed; E 'Enemies caught in between are damaged, stunned and Marked'; R 'blades form a wall that will damage and slow'. Nothing grants a shield, and the CC is plainly there. Telling an Akali player Irelia has no CC gets her stunned and killed.
audit.corrected: whys[4], whys[5], whys[6], spikes[1].text, spikes[2].text, spikes[3].text, mid, late, wants.foe[0..2] rewritten. Added the genuinely useful interaction that was missing: Defiant Dance reduces PHYSICAL damage only, so her charge stance does nothing against Akali's kit.

audit.whatIsWrong: All seven chart rows disagreed between layers: phases[].side read Irelia/Irelia/Irelia/Irelia/Skill/Skill/Skill while win[] read Akali on all seven. The full layer also rated four Irelia-owned rows at 7/10 in Akali's favour, which reads backwards.
audit.why: 51.84% over 2913 games is a slight Akali edge. Irelia genuinely owns 1-2: Bladesurge costs 15 mana, heals, and refreshes on kills, so she resets through the wave while Akali counts energy. From 4-5 onward Akali takes over — Defiant Dance must be charged standing still, and Perfect Execution's 120s beats Vanguard's Edge's 125s.
audit.corrected: Reconciled chart, both layers, matched pairs: Irelia, Irelia, Skill, Akali, Akali, Akali, Akali, with ratings fixed so Irelia rows sit below 5/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 spike was justified by a non-existent shield interaction rather than by the real ultimate maths.
audit.why: Perfect Execution is 120/90/60; Vanguard's Edge is 125/105/85. Akali's ult window arrives first on every cycle, and her first-item spike is really about Grievous Wounds shutting down Bladesurge's heal.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why, phases[5].why, whys[4], whys[5] and spikes[1].text rewritten around the real cooldowns and the anti-heal timing.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers, and 'Her stun setup — dodge it and the dive falls apart' was the entire cooldown section.
audit.why: Flawless Duet is 16/14.5/13/11.5/10 — that is the window. Bladesurge is 10 down to 6 but refreshes on a Marked target, so the stun effectively buys her a free reset. Defiant Dance is 20 down to 12.
audit.corrected: Real numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[2].d, phases[0..5].why and several whys.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Add anti-heal early into his sustain' — vague, wrong pronoun, no source named.
audit.why: The sustain is Bladesurge, which heals her on every dash and refreshes on Marks and kills.
audit.corrected: report[8].t now names Grievous Wounds against Bladesurge.

edits.after: With a first item and beyond you keep winning solo skirmishes, provided you open from outside the Flawless Duet line — she does have a stun, and a Mark on you refreshes Bladesurge. Your Shroud is still a disengage she cannot replicate.

Akali's R was called a true-damage execute; Riot's text does not say true damage. 'Transcendent Blades' is not an Irelia ability. All corrected.
